links.outcome: Sensitivity and agreement across prompt variants and repeated inference runs
links.effect: Prompt variants and inference stochasticity produced 2-3x sensitivity swings and run-to-run kappa ranging from 0.20 to 0.85.
links.quote: Prompts and inference stochasticity introduced 2-3× sensitivity swings and run-to-run κ from 0.20 to 0.85.

links.outcome: Radiologist versus multimodal LLM performance on thoracic device assessment, paired comparison
links.effect: Radiologists numerically outperformed all three LLMs in 42/42 paired comparisons; significant after Bonferroni correction in 33/42 (32/42 at p < 0.001).
links.quote: Radiologists numerically outperformed all three LLMs in 42/42 paired comparisons; the superiority was statistically significant after Bonferroni correction in 33/42 (32/42 at p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial multimodal LLMs on a retrospective chest radiograph benchmark and reader study for thoracic device detection and positioning, including sensitivity analyses and failure taxonomy, but does not test a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
